title: Effective Federal Funds Rate (DFF) — Daily Observation
summary: The Effective Federal Funds Rate (EFFR) stood at 3.64% as of April 23, 2026, unchanged from the prior observation on April 22. The rate has remained flat at 3.64% across the five trading days from April 19 through April 23, 2026, indicating stable overnight funding conditions in the federal funds market.

why_it_matters: The EFFR is the key policy rate benchmark for short-term funding markets. A flat reading at 3.64% over five consecutive days suggests the Fed's target rate is holding steady and overnight funding conditions are stable. This data point confirms the current monetary policy stance without signaling any change.

market_structure_context: The EFFR is the weighted average rate at which overnight funds are traded between depository institutions in the federal funds market. Five consecutive flat readings at 3.64% reflect a stable overnight rate environment consistent with the current federal funds target range.
